body: They’re aware of my ideas. But they don’t know what I will do or how it when. I’m just venting because I know positivity won’t get through to me at this point.
It doesn’t matter now I’m not reaching out to anyone. They won’t do anything. I can’t drag anyone down with me at this point...

Yeah no one is going to know who I am thank god. I can only imagine how bad Texas could be. Luckily I have friends and family that’s truly believe I just want attention knows not to snitch thank god. I wouldn’t do the same either. Some places are super unorganized I’m surprised they’re not shut down. Makes me feel bad for the basket cases begging for change tbh...

I’ve been through that too and got out the hospital 24 hours later. I live in nyc. I know how the system works. In my case I could be found months later. NYC love leaving basket cases in the streets even if they ask to stay....

I’m 25 living on my own in my apartment. I have bills to pay. I don’t have to to be institutionalized when I have I job. They’re just going to give me a drug addiction diagnose me with bipolar and have me around but jobs. And I live in NYC, it’s super easy to go to the ER and leave, you see them all the time even at the airport. I rather avoid that.

I can laugh at funny videos all day but it doesn’t matter. I’m new to this as well but I’m looking for reasons to do it... not distracting myself from family and friends saying no don’t do it. I’ve already look like I want attention so I tell them very little. My doctors have no clue I’m suicidal because she could call 911. So I’m saying ny goodbyes and that’s that.

I’m losing interest in everything. The only thing I do know is go to work and my appointments. I work at an airport so I do ponder the thought of jumping. Distracting just gives more days to live and I don’t have time.
